reuse.reason: The pinned official product-analytics requires authenticated Desktop Host telemetry with account and Session context. It has no site public-page, administrator consent, merchant-conversion or GA4 provider contract that can be mounted or adapted without changing its product behavior. This custom plugin owns canonical published-page validation, first-party daily conversion counts, server-confirmed event receipts, optional consented GA4 transport and an administrator-only aggregate read API. It loads no browser tracking SDK, creates no persistent visitor identity, and uses the existing D1 database with additive tables.
gaps: First-party counts deduplicate real registrations, first completed activation per account, checkout creation and verified paid events. Google sends require explicit consent and make at most one attempt; HTTP acceptance is not proof of ingestion. No automatic retries, persistent visitors or cross-session attribution. Activation remains first-party only because background completions carry no browser consent.
